Roger Guenveur Smith delivers a captivating celebration of community in his solo show, honoring not just Jean-Michel Basquiat but the sprawling collection of people who are inextricably embedded into their bond and their works.
In Honor of Jean-Michel Basquiat is fascinating, discursive, poetic — and delivered in about an hour with the barefoot confidence of a veteran sideman from some smoky downtown club.

cn.t: Roger Guenveur Smith delivers a poetic, jazz-inflected solo show blending memoir and history as he honors his late friend Basquiat. Critics praise its singular, personal approach and Smith's compelling performance.
